prompt: In a vibrant anime style illustration set inside a bustling fire station, a firefighter in a yellow helmet stands on the left, holding a coiled hose with a determined expression. Next to him, a dalmatian with black spots sits calmly, looking up at the firefighter with attentive eyes. In the center of the room, a mechanic in blue overalls leans against a shiny red fire truck, wiping grease from his hands with a rag. To the right, a captain in a formal uniform points toward a large wall map, discussing strategy with a rookie in a grey shirt who stands beside her, nodding earnestly. A small tabby cat sleeps peacefully on top of a wooden desk in the background, curled into a tight ball. The scene captures the daily routine and camaraderie of the station crew. There is no smoke or fire visible in the station.
